method.pixelMethod: One full source image per result; all 45 pages individually inspected, with rotated upright table pages. Text extraction only assisted navigation.

sourceAssertions: Full monster-profile recapitulation is excluded under the documented bestiary scope; this does not exclude operative XP qualifiers or facts consumed by exposed spells.

The repeated tenfold-XP permanent-kill versus destruction-of-material-form footnote applies to ten starred named rows: Demogorgon, Juiblex, Orcus, Yeenoghu, Asmodeus, Baalzebul, Dispater, Geryon, Chromatic Dragon and Platinum Dragon. Current generic XP cards do not encode it.
Variable-XP and guards/leaders markers and family continuations were inspected; the lookup rows were not independently cell-transcribed.
Loacath has a four-star marker while the nearby not-rateable legend appears with five stars. Their semantic equivalence is unestablished; no rule is invented.
limitations: Profile-row denominator is excluded, not a numeric-validation pass. Spell-consumed profiles are cross-referenced to the MM exposed-spell review.

sourceAssertions: Craps, Horse, Knucklebones, Slot Variant, Zowie Slot Variant, Dice Racing, In Between, Twenty One and High/Low are source procedures.
Twenty One crosses p.215 bottom right to p.216 top left; equality/house ties, split pair and under-22-five-card conditions are substantive.
No current owner represents these games or payoff tables. Incidental dice/game words are not a procedure join.
The table has 24 left-column and 22 right-column physical bands, with wrapped passage entries counted once.
Trap detection, spells and exploration concepts are present; the 46-outcome trap-design table is absent.
Introductory and Arch-example prose cross columns/pages. Seven worked examples are Altar, Arch, Container, Secret Door, Fountain, Monster and Pedestal.
Rope Trick and animal-training trick references do not encode this source procedure.
The obsidian-vase example has an encounter value of 5,000 gp, not a standard purchase price.
Direct selection is primary; random results fill and round out the design. Noise distance and spacing guidance is part of the procedure.
Individual equipment names do not represent the 15 selection tables. Clothing/food lists have source cross-references and deliberately incomplete variety.
Physical bands, not all d100 positions or every numeric cell, form this denominator.
The list supplies reputed folk uses as inspiration for magical preparations; effects remain a DM decision. It supplies no modern medical efficacy, dose, or proficiency-check system.
Nine literal question marks and Blueberry/Bilberry and Leek/Chives cross-reference rows are preserved as source features.
Garlic, belladonna and wolvesbane purchase cards do not represent the plant-use list.
Color choices continue on p.222. The source offers optional descriptive vocabulary, not fixed identification mechanics.
No captured card supplies these grouped choice lists.
Both exposed Conjure Animals spells represent the general HD budget and fractional additional-hit-point treatment.
The animal-choice table, category-specific costs, random type selection, whale ceiling and aquatic-location condition are absent.
High categories without explicit dice bands are not assigned invented probabilities. The source wording about fractions is retained as written.
All seven spell owners exist and describe general summons/control. The 129 physical lookup rows and freshwater/saltwater alternatives are absent.
Evil-caster parenthetical alternatives and source permission/preference for DM selection/random selection are operative qualifiers.
The tables implement exposed spells; full-monster-profile exclusion does not exclude them.
Bibliographic inspiration is excluded as editorial reading material; its absence is not counted as rule coverage.

All 64 source rows are individually classified below. The 26 represented physical rows have 28 distinct value-field owners; a 29th field owner is the thieves-tools prose exemption outside the table. Across row values plus citation-only matches, there are 38 distinct owner routes and 42 reference edges.
Ten citation-only source rows have matching cards/chips but no displayed encumbrance fact; twenty-eight other rows have no represented p.225 fact.

General bulk and accessibility concepts are present. The instrument-size note, 1,500-gp normal-strength ceiling, four exemption categories, missing-item analogy procedure and worked example are not fully represented.
Thieves picks/tools exemption is already explicitly represented; no duplicate fix is required.
Staff p.225 and PHB quarterstaff approximate weight are different source labels/fields; no numeric contradiction is inferred.
The shared ability method (four d6, discard lowest, arrange) exists elsewhere. Normal eligibility remains required.
The quick-party alignment, level conversion/round-up, carrying guidance and protective/weapon/scroll/potion procedures are not represented.
The source may let qualifying characters choose potions and describes a 100%-or-more mandatory choice condition; dashes are not zeroes.
The miscellaneous list crosses p.227 columns; robe options select 7–12 of 23. Its 100-gp gem and fifty silver coins are encounter contents, not purchase prices.
Static source reference content is in scope even though an interactive character generator is deferred.
Every physical head is separately classified below. Existing rule meaning can be present without a dedicated glossary document. Mere word occurrences do not establish the definition.
Editorial Latin abbreviations and external unavailable Module D3 profiles have explicit exclusions, never counted as present.
Generic percentage magic resistance is a confirmed omission, distinct from racial saving bonuses and PC exceptions.
The glossary death threshold differs from the detailed p.82 procedure; this source variation is recorded without rewriting mechanics.
The DM-arbitration editorial essay and art are excluded from rule transcription; absence is not a completeness pass.
The combined DMG/PHB index is expressly non-exhaustive, so it is navigation evidence rather than a source-content denominator.
The previous outline range 231–238 is superseded: p.236 is advertising and pp.237–238 are substantive reference sheets. These new source units are below.
